facts.mutual_relationship: maximum love, trust, loyalty, protection, and support; permanently non-hostile
facts.relationship_rule: love and loyalty do not erase disagreement, fear, secrecy required by duty, or different judgments about risk

items: Tang Zhu to Tang Wei: proud and protective; tests practical judgment; will challenge weak reasoning without withdrawing support.
Tang Ling to Tang Wei: affectionate and candid; protects his agency by giving material facts and consequences rather than choosing for him.
Tang Kai to Tang Wei: adoring younger brother; complete trust; seeks inclusion and attention.
Tang Wei's feelings and chosen responses remain player-owned and are not inferred from these relationships.

Shen Rui to Tang Kai and House Tang: permanent lifetime loyalty; protective guardian; quietly challenges avoidable exposure.
Wei Jian to House Tang: permanent covenant loyalty; institution-first honesty; no sycophancy.

records.label: Sworn and covenant relationships

items: Tang Wei: House Tang and Sword Manor internal state, ordinary public conditions, the opened Kanyou report, and his own announced intention to seek Qin military service, preferably under Duke Hyou if a real route exists, while taking Tang Kai so Kai can witness battle.
Tang Zhu: House Tang readiness, Tang Ling's outer Kanyou summary, and Tang Wei's announced Qin-service and Tang-Kai intentions. He has not been given the opened report's full inner contents.

Tang Ling: courier chain, outer intelligence summary, House Tang political exposure, the opened inner slips shared with Tang Wei, and Tang Wei's announced Qin-service and Tang-Kai intentions. She has not shared the inner contents with others in this scene.

Tang Kai: family routines, familiar people, visible moods, concrete objects, and Tang Wei's statement that he intends to take Kai with him to see battle. Kai does not possess an adult understanding of battle danger, military service, or political alignment.

Duan Jin and Shen Rui: inner security, retinue readiness, and report metadata only; they have not been given the opened Kanyou report's inner contents or brought into the family enlistment discussion yet.
Wei Jian: Sword Manor obligations, personnel, training, and reported city conditions; no House Tang sealed-report contents and no delivered notice yet of Tang Wei's Qin-service intention.
Other staff: their professional domains and information lawfully delivered to them.
